# DueFox - Automated B2B Invoice Chasing & Payment Recovery

> DueFox.co is an automated invoice-chasing SaaS platform for freelancers, solopreneurs, and agencies.

## Key Features
- Automated payment reminders via Email and WhatsApp.
- Progressive tone escalation (Polite nudges to urgent escalations).
- Custom payment options (UPI, Bank details, Checkout links).
- 7-day free trial with No Credit Card required.

## Pricing Tiers
- Pro Plan: $9/month
- Agency Plan: $49/month
